page.content:
The Clover Branch is one of two known branches of Heartland Duel School in the Xyz Dimension in the Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V anime. They are rivals with the school's Spade Branch. The school trains professional Duelists.

page.overview:
Who is Clover Branch?

The Clover Branch is one of two known branches of Heartland Duel School in the Xyz Dimension in the Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V anime. They are rivals with the school's Spade Branch. The school trains professional Duelists.

Prior to the invasion of Heartland City, Yusho Sakaki taught at this Branch. Among his students were Alan, Kite Tenjo and Saya Sasayama.

After the invasion, students from this school formed parts of the Resistance, including Alan, Saya and Kite.
